svg.title: Mo62A board features: clockwise numbered locations
svg.desc: The original component-side board image, with its original viewing angle preserved. Fourteen numbered callouts run clockwise from the J6 40-pin header at the top. Number 03 identifies both pairs of USB sockets. Connector descriptions and J6 pin orientation are provided separately in the page text.
svg.metadata: Embedded original PNG SHA-256: afee288a01ac2de5aadf3d1d6e4bb1692bbcdf2e5620b1217915b188962c1fe7. Original raster dimensions: 1474 by 1067 pixels. Image bytes, aspect ratio and viewing angle are unchanged. Numbers identify physical locations only; they are not connector pin numbers.

g.aria-label: 03: Four USB 2.0 ports in two stacked pairs
